title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 11 MARCH 2026 Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 11 March 2026. A few showers are likely in Northern and Eastern provinces. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Sabaragamuwa, Southern and Uva provinces and in Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts in the evening or night. Mainly dry weather will prevail elsewhere over the island. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Central, Sabaragamuwa and Uva provinces and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
